job_description.description: Format a raw job posting into a clean, structured HTML document.

elements.content: em tag: Job description saved on [Today's Date]

css_rules: body { font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; }
h2 { font-size: 18px; margin-top: 25px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ccc; padding-bottom: 5px; }
job_description.ai_instructions: Parse the raw job posting text into the sections above. Extract: job title, company name, location, employment type, a 2-3 sentence summary, 4-8 key responsibilities as bullet points, and 4-8 requirements as bullet points. Use text-align: left for body text.

resume.description: Generate a print-ready ATS-optimized resume tailored to the target job.
required_css_classes: h1 — candidate full name, centered, uppercase, 22pt
.job-title-row — flex row with company-name left, job-title right italic
.edu-entry — education entry with job-date-location, company-name, job-title
.cert-entry — conditional certifications (SafeCheck only for kitchen/cook roles)
sections_order: h2: Professional Experience → .job-entry blocks (1-3 most relevant)
h2: Certifications → .cert-entry (only for kitchen/cook category, SafeCheck only)
ats_notes: Do NOT use text-align: justify on resume elements except .summary p and ul.achievements li
Do NOT use flex-direction column-reverse, CSS multi-columns, or complex grid
Use -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact on body for print
Include SafeCheck Advanced Food Safety Certification ONLY when category includes food-handling duties
Tailor skills to match keywords from the job description
Target A4 page size — do not assume US Letter
Avoid position: fixed/sticky, CSS multi-columns, vh/vw units, JavaScript
All colored elements must have print-color-adjust: exact
resume.ai_instructions: Using the MASTER DATA and TARGET JOB provided, generate the resume HTML body (no <html>, <head>, or <body> tags). Fill in the Professional Summary with 3-4 sentences tailored to the job. Extract 3-4 Skills categories with relevant skills. For Professional Experience, select the 1-3 most relevant past jobs and tailor their achievement bullets to match the job requirements — use concrete metrics where available. For Education, list 1-2 most relevant entries. Do NOT invent content not in the master data. Follow the PRINT-SAFE CSS COMPATIBILITY GUIDE in src/lib/print-safe-css.ts — the output is rendered to PDF via the browser's print engine.

cover_letter.description: Generate a print-ready cover letter tailored to the target job and company.
required_css_classes: .sender-block — top section with sender name and meta
p — paragraphs with text-align: justify (required on all p tags)
sections_order: p (para 1): Express strong interest, mention specific role and company, hook sentence
p (para 2): Key achievements matching the requirements — use concrete metrics
p (para 3): Closing with availability, call to action
content_rules: Date must be in 'Month DD, YYYY' format (e.g., 'May 26, 2026')
Always use 'Dear Hiring Team at [Company],' as opener unless company name is unknown
Do NOT use bullet points in cover letter body
Do NOT invent achievements — derive from master resume data only
Availability statement and contact info in closing paragraph
cover_letter.ai_instructions: Using the CANDIDATE DATA and TARGET JOB (company, position, summary, requirements), write a professional cover letter as HTML body only (without <html>, <head>, or <body> tags). Follow the exact section order and CSS classes. Use paragraphs with style='text-align: justify'. Date format: Month DD, YYYY. Do not invent content not present in the candidate data. Target A4 page size and follow the PRINT-SAFE CSS COMPATIBILITY GUIDE in src/lib/print-safe-css.ts — the output is rendered to PDF via the browser's print engine.
